methodology: All 736 ZigZag V3, 107 Multitimeframe V3 and 44 Stochastic V3 trades are retained.
At entry, each trade reserves 1% of the portfolio equity then available.
Overlapping trades remain open independently and settle using their original realized R.
No signal is removed because another component has an open or opposing position.
limitations: Compounding makes monetary profit non-linear and substantially increases exposure after equity growth.
Maximum simultaneous loss can reach approximately 3% before slippage and gap risk.
The combined strategy remains shadow-only pending independent broker-tick forward validation.
